citations.chunk_text: Grant amounts are grouped by gov_organisation_name and ordered by SUM(grant_received).

warnings.message: Bounded deterministic SQL fast path used for production main-flow funding ranking.

sql_query: SELECT gov_organisation_name, COUNT(*) AS grant_count, SUM(grant_received) AS total_grant, ROUND(SUM(grant_received) / 10000000.0, 2) AS total_grant_crore FROM innovation_grant_from_govt GROUP BY gov_organisation_name ORDER BY total_grant DESC LIMIT 5
